summary: Rick Grigsby, 62, of Estes Park fell in a steep off-trail area between Arch Rock and The Pool on the lower Fern Lake Trail, suffering a leg injury; RMNP SAR searched off-trail areas for four hours before locating him by his yells; technical lowerings of 1,000 ft and 800 ft followed by a wheeled litter carry reached the Fern Lake Trailhead at 2:30 a.m.
location: Lower Fern Lake Trail between Arch Rock and The Pool
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: NPS news release dated 2015-06-11; 40+ park SAR members responded; burn-scar slide area from the 2012 Fern Lake Fire. [run 654: NPT merge, parent-opened URL]
